subject: Coupa invite failing: path encoding breaks SSO handoff
messages:
From: Nadia Park <nadia.park@ironcladfab.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa invite not working (SSO redirect error)

Hi Rafael / Laura,

We tried to accept the supplier portal invite you sent this morning for Ironclad Fabrications, but the link lands on an error page at Coupa. Screenshot attached (screen-coupa-error.png). The page shows: "400 Bad Request - RelayState encoding invalid".

Details: when I click the invite I get a long URL with relayState=%252Fapp%252Fsession%252F... — looks like portions of the path have been double-encoded (%25). Our team uses Okta as the IdP; when Okta receives the relaystate it seems to fail validation. Tried in Chrome and Edge with same result.

Can you resend the invite or provide a temporary direct link? We really need to finish bank details and upload the W9 to get the first PO processed.

Thanks,
Nadia Park
Finance Manager
Ironclad Fabrications

Attachment: screen-coupa-error.png (image/png)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Park <nadia.park@ironcladfab.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Jun 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa invite not working (SSO redirect error)

Hi Nadia — thanks for the clear screenshot, and sorry for the friction.

This looks like a RelayState/path encoding issue we've seen when invite links are proxied through certain email clients or when our redirect service double-encodes paths. Two quick mitigations to try right away:

- Open the invite link in an incognito/private window (bypasses some mail-to-browser plugins).
- If that doesn't work, copy-paste the link into a plain text editor and replace any %252F with %2F (i.e., un-double-encode the slashes) then paste into the browser.

I'm attaching a short checklist (vendor-onboarding-steps.pdf) with steps to finish bank/W9 uploads in case you can accept via the workaround. If neither helps I'll generate a direct acceptance token that bypasses the redirect stage and set up a one-time manual invite.

We're also opening an internal ticket with ops to fix the encoding at the redirect layer — CC'ing Ben to help escalate with Coupa if needed.

Apologies again — we know this blocks PO flow. I'll follow up within the hour with a direct link if you still hit the error.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor-onboarding-steps.pdf (application/pdf)

Looping in from Ops side. Rafael — filing SUP-4232 now (link copied to thread). Nadia — sorry for the trouble. We can create a direct acceptance URL that skips the RelayState handoff (one-time token) and email that to you; it should let you finish profile + bank details without hitting Okta.

Work plan:
- Short term (today): I'll generate a direct token and send it to you. Please use it in an incognito window if possible.
- Mid term: Ops will patch the redirect service to avoid double-encoding the path; that will prevent this from recurring for other suppliers.
- Escalation: If Coupa's SSO refuses the token we may need a small config change on their side to accept longer relayState values — Ops will coordinate.

Nadia, can you confirm which browser + version you tested? That helps triage.

Ben
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
